cardOverview.overviewText: A Zen Signature card offering accelerated rewards on travel and lifestyle categories, with milestone benefits and global lounge access.

benefitRows.name: Priority Pass
benefitRows.offer: Cardholders are not liable for fraudulent transactions due to loss or theft if reported to the bank within 7 days. Additionally, they receive an insurance cover worth ₹2.5 lakh.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Visit the Priority Pass activation page. Enter your membership number and validation code. If required, provide the last four digits of your payment card associated with the membership
